items.title: Implement sessionId and the owner-lease.json core
items.context: Stable per-session `sessionId` — a LOCAL process-coordination id only (NOT cryptographic identity; no keys / server authority / attestation — hard boundary 1). `.koala/story/actives/<storyId>/owner-lease.json` records sessionId / hostname / pid / cwd / command / acquiredAt / heartbeatAt / optional human label. The first story-scoped mutating command for a story acquires the owner lease; owner commands refresh heartbeatAt; the lease is released when the story reaches DONE/DISCARDED and cleanup succeeds. The lease file is process metadata, not product evidence — visible in session_brief but never counted as verification evidence.
items.userSees: 用户/agent 在 story dir 看到 .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/owner-lease.json，含 sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt；同一 session 再跑命令时 heartbeatAt 被刷新。

happy.desc: sessionId 稳定生成（同一 session 内一致）；第一条 story-scoped mutating 命令为 story 写出 owner-lease.json，含 sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt
owner 后续 story-scoped mutating 命令刷新 owner-lease.json 的 heartbeatAt

edge.desc: story 到 DONE/DISCARDED 且 cleanup 成功后 owner lease 释放
owner-lease.json 是进程元数据——在 session_brief 可见、但不计入 verification evidence

adversarial.desc: owner-lease.json 不在 DONE 前留未提交脏写（防 F-008 同类 partial-DONE）

verificationEvidence.note: smoke sections 1+2 assert sessionId is process-stable (memoized, same value every call) and acquireOwnerLease writes owner-lease.json at the canonical path with every schema field (sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt) populated and acquiredAt===heartbeatAt on first acquire

smoke section 3 asserts an owner re-running a story-scoped mutating command via refreshOwnerLease advances ONLY heartbeatAt while preserving acquiredAt/sessionId/original command; section 5 covers acquire-or-refresh refreshing for the same session
smoke section 4 asserts releaseOwnerLease removes owner-lease.json (the terminal-state DONE/DISCARDED cleanup release path) and is idempotent — releasing an absent lease is a no-op false

owner-lease.json is process metadata only: the CHK-001 lease module (story-owner-lease.ts) writes nothing into the verificationEvidence pipeline and is registered in runtime-artifact-registry as materialHash:exclude — it is excluded from material hashing and never enters gate evidence; smoke section 7 asserts the material-excluded classification. session_brief rendering of the lease is CHK-004 scope

smoke section 7 asserts the F-008-class dirty-write prevention: owner-lease.json is a registered runtime artifact (runtime-story-owner-lease entry — volatile + materialHash:exclude) and the runtime ignore patterns include the glob-star owner-lease.json pattern; .gitignore also carries it, so the lease is never tracked and never produces an uncommitted dirty write that could block the DONE git merge

items.title: Non-owner story-scoped mutating command rejection gate
items.context: Build the rejection gate STRICTLY from the command-classification table that PLAN produces first (every command classified read-only / story-scoped mutating / main-shared mutating / dangerous — hard boundary 2: no missing commands, no wrongly-blocked read-only commands). Non-owner story-scoped mutating commands fail closed with owner guidance. Read-only commands (story_get / checklist_get / finding_list / session_brief / ...) never require a lease (hard boundary 3). CRITICAL reviewer-writes fork: reviewer writes (finding_add / review_pass_set) must NOT be gated by the main-agent owner lease — they take an actor/lane-scoped exception or their own current-review-run gate so three-way balance is preserved; the exact mechanism is decided in the PLAN decision. Reviewer writes still record actor/session.
items.userSees: 非 owner session 跑 checklist_update 等 story-scoped mutating 命令时看到 fail-closed 的 owner-guidance 错误；read-only 命令照常返回；command-ownership contract test 全绿。

happy.desc: 每个已注册 command 在 CommandPolicy 都有 ownershipClass（readOnly/storyScopedMutating/reviewerWrite/mainSharedMutating/dangerousMutating）——contract test 枚举真实 registry 断言全覆盖、缺一即 fail
非 owner session 跑 story-scoped mutating 命令（如 checklist_update）被 fail-closed 拒绝，附 owner guidance

edge.desc: read-only 命令在任何 session 永不被 owner lease 拦
finding_resolve/finding_dismiss owner-gated；但 B-META finding 的 resolve/dismiss 归 mainSharedMutating、走 B-f60c main write lock 不走 owner lease
validate --story=B-xxx owner-gated；不带 --story 的纯诊断型 validate 不要求 story owner lease

adversarial.desc: reviewer-write 豁免窄：main agent 不能借 delivery_check_set 绕过 owner lease——delivery_check_set 仅在 actor/lane=delivery reviewer 时算 reviewerWrite，否则按 storyScopedMutating 或拒绝
未分类（缺 ownershipClass）的命令 gate fail-closed，不默认放行

items.title: Stale lease detection and takeover
items.context: A lease is stale after 30 minutes without a heartbeat. `--takeover` transfers a STALE lease to the current session and records an event. A non-stale lease requires explicit `--forceTakeover` (treated as human-approved). Takeover is dangerous-mutating-command discipline — explicit intent required, event recorded.
items.userSees: owner 离线 30 分钟后，新 session 跑 koala <cmd> --takeover 看到 lease 转移成功提示并记录 takeover event；对活跃 lease 跑 --takeover 被拒、提示需 --forceTakeover。

happy.desc: owner lease heartbeatAt 超过 30 分钟无刷新 → 判 stale
--takeover 把 stale lease 转移给当前 session 并记录一条 takeover event

edge.desc: 非 stale（活跃）lease 不能被 --takeover，需显式 --forceTakeover（视为人工批准）

adversarial.desc: 无 --takeover/--forceTakeover 时不转移任何 lease；takeover 走 dangerous-mutating 纪律、记录 event

items.title: Ownership-aware error UX and session_brief rendering
items.context: Non-owner mutation error message per the doc's Error UX: which story is owned, owner sessionId / cwd / last-heartbeat age, whether the lease is stale, the allowed next action. session_brief ownership rendering: owner session, owner cwd, last heartbeat age, stale/active status, whether the current session is the owner, and recommended action (proceed / read-only only / takeover available / wait). For B-META, session_brief shows shared audit state separately and must not suggest story_advance.
items.userSees: 非 owner 跑 mutating 命令看到 "B-xxxx is owned by session <id>, heartbeat <n>m ago. Use read-only commands, wait for the owner, or rerun with --takeover after the lease is stale."；koala session_brief 一屏显示 owner/cwd/heartbeat/stale|active/是否本 session/推荐动作。

happy.desc: 非 owner mutation 错误消息含：哪个 story 被 own、owner sessionId/cwd/last-heartbeat、是否 stale、允许的下一步动作
session_brief 渲染 owner session / owner cwd / heartbeat age / stale|active / 当前 session 是否 owner / 推荐动作（proceed|read-only|takeover available|wait）

edge.desc: B-META 在 session_brief 单独显示 shared audit state，且不建议 story_advance

adversarial.desc: owner lease 不阻断 reviewer read-only flow——story_get/checklist_get/finding_list/session_brief 在非 owner session 仍放行

items.title: doctor stale-lease check and multi-session regression smoke
items.context: doctor detects stale story owner leases and reports them. Multi-session regression smoke per the doc's Acceptance Criteria: two sessions mutating the same story -> second rejected with owner guidance; two sessions on different stories -> both proceed; stale-lease takeover allowed only with explicit takeover + event record; active-lease takeover rejected unless forceTakeover; session_brief tells a non-owner session to wait or stay read-only; existing read-only reviewer workflows still work; reviewer writes still succeed via the lane-scoped exception.
items.userSees: koala validate 输出含新增 story-owner-lease smoke 与 command-ownership contract 全部 PASS；doctor 输出含 stale owner lease 报告行。

happy.desc: koala doctor 检出并报告 stale story owner lease
smoke：两 session 对同一 story 跑 mutating → 第二个被拒并附 owner guidance；两 session 对不同 story → 都正常推进

edge.desc: smoke：stale-lease takeover 仅在显式 --takeover + event 记录下允许；active-lease takeover 被拒（除非 --forceTakeover）
smoke：非 owner session 下 reviewer read-only flow 与 reviewer-write（合法 reviewer run 下）仍成功

adversarial.desc: smoke：owner-lease.json 在 DONE 前后无未提交脏写（F-008 同类回归断言）
koala validate 全绿（含新增 story-owner-lease smoke 与 command-ownership contract）
